business_summary: Zhejiang Dehong Automotive Electronic & Electrical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, sale, and services of automobile alternators in China and internationally. Its products are used in commercial vehicles, passenger cars, aftermarket products, electronic vacuum pumps, and energy storage equipment. The company was formerly known as Shenhu Automobile Electrical Machinery Factory and changed its name to Zhejiang Dehong Automotive Electronic & Electrical Co., Ltd. in January 2000. Zhejiang Dehong Automotive Electronic & Electrical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1978 and is headquartered in Huzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Zhejiang Dehong Automotive Electronic & Electrical Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 자동차 교류 발전기의 연구, 개발, 제조, 판매 및 서비스에 참여합니다. 해당 제품은 상용차, 승용차, 부품시장 제품, 전자 진공 펌프, 에너지 저장 장비에 사용됩니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Shenhu Automobile Electrical Machinery Factory로 알려졌으며 2000년 1월에 Zhejiang Dehong Automotive Electronic & Electrical Co., Ltd.로 이름을 변경했습니다. Zhejiang Dehong Automotive Electronic & Electrical Co., Ltd.는 1978년에 설립되었으며 중국 후저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
